about_the_game:
Underside: The Lift - A single-player horror roguelike with survival elements.

Try to survive in a house where every apartment could be your last.

You find yourself in a familiar yet distorted place,

as if you’ve entered its darker reflection.

As if you’ve stepped into the Underside.

The silence is suffocating. There’s something behind every door.

Unfamiliar sounds echo like whispers in the dark — unsettling and real.

All you have is an old pipe and a lighter.

Try different weapons. Search for notes. Study your enemies.

Each monster has its own weaknesses.

No direct hints. Only observation and experience.

One life. One chance.

Die and start over.

Every run is a new house.

New layout, new monsters, new challenges.

Remember: nothing ever repeats here.

The lift is the only place where you can catch your breath,

sort your supplies, and prepare for the next encounter.

This is where the journey begins.

This is where you return. If you're lucky.

content_descriptors.notes:
This game contains scenes of violence against fictional monsters, including blood, dead bodies, and a severed monster head. Some written notes may reference themes of psychological abuse, addiction, and sexual topics. The character uses alcohol and cigarettes to restore mental stability. The game also includes references to the aftermath of suicide.

This content may be disturbing or uncomfortable for some players.

short_description: A single-player survival roguelike horror game with randomly generated locations and permanent death. A mysterious labyrinth of post-Soviet apartments draws you into an atmosphere of solitude and plunges you into the darkness of the unknown.
